mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month averages signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 12-month averages, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), rising joblessness signals economic distress and reduced consumer spending, depressing corporate profits and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100,000 monthly additions) consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as labor market strength compounds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) above their 12-month averages signals strong aggregate demand momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 exceed 12-month averages, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), persistent inflation erodes corporate margins and triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.
